committee_papers.note: Committee reports, update sheets and minutes are published here. The update sheet and minutes, which carry the committee's changes, are not on the Idox documents tab. Committee id confirmed by the Modern.gov web service on 2026-09-26.

quirks.summary: Committee update sheets and minutes are not on the Idox documents tab; they are on the council's Modern.gov committee system.
quirks.detail: A retrieval that stops at Idox misses the material showing what the committee changed on the night. The host and committee id are in portal.committee_papers.
quirks.workaround: For a committee decision, fetch the report, update sheet and minutes from the committee system before recording any of them as missing.
